title: Cheap Netherite
description: This datapack aims to make both netherite and netherite upgrade trims more easy to obtain
body:
This datapack makes both netherite and netherite upgrade trims more easy to obtain, eliminating the struggle of wandering through the nether for an upgrade trim only to waste your diamonds on more of them
